name: std::ranges::join_view<V>::begin
intro:
Returns an iterator to the first element of the join_view. Given base_ is the underlying view,

1) Equivalent to
 return /*iterator*/<true>{*this, ranges::begin(base_)}; if /*simple-view*/<V> is satisfied and ranges::range_reference_t<V> is reference type. Otherwise,
 return /*iterator*/<false>{*this, ranges::begin(base_)};.

2) Equivalent to return /*iterator*/<true>{*this, ranges::begin(base_)};.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: When ranges::range_reference_t<V> is not a reference type, that is, deferencing an iterator of V returns a prvalue temporary, the join_view is only an input_range, in which case only single-pass iteration is supported, and repeated calls to begin() may not give meaningful results.
